title: Concrete target-chain bar retraction
statement: For the enlarged diagram [def-sc-compact-flat-bar-index], let J be the target chain lifted to the source universe and let r be its least-block retraction [lem-sc-compact-flat-bar-index-adjunction]. Define the target-chain bar, its inclusion into the full bar, and the retraction induced by r and the diagram map of the adjunction unit x<=J(r(x)). Both maps commute with augmentation.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Concrete target-chain bar retraction.

proof.text: Lift the natural-number chain by ULift. Restrict the enlarged diagram and cocone to it. Reindexing with identity components gives target inclusion. Reindexing along the lifted least-block order map, with components given by the diagram map on the adjunction unit, gives retraction. Thinness of the preorder and diagram functoriality prove the transformation is natural. totalAugmentation_naturality proves both augmentation identities.
